name: Ferim
source:
The being who transcends time - otherwise known as the Time Manager. Stoic, unearthly, and above all mysterious. One can't help to wonder what is creeping under that hood.

Other than certains things, he expects you to figure everything out on your own. He can be found in Area-X.

[from [url=http://www.zeiva.net/otome/area_x_cast_belph.html]official site[/url]]
